verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms an llms.txt returns HTTP 200 at checkout.com/llms.txt, and a second docs-scoped llms.txt (checkout.com/docs/llms.txt) indexes product and API content for agents. The beta MCP server also gives agents structured access to the latest API reference and integration guides. Missing for 10: markdown renditions of docs pages (docs.md probe returned 404), evidence of an llms-full.txt, and independent corroboration of how well agents use these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Request a payment using a token, a network token, a payment instrument, or the full card details.
